classification.difficultyReason: Construct three different rectangles for each specified area by choosing different pairs of dimensions.

content.prompt: For each part below, draw three different rectangles with the given area.

answer.short: Sample answers: rectangles measuring $12\text{ cm}\times1\text{ cm}$, $6\text{ cm}\times2\text{ cm}$ and $4\text{ cm}\times3\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
Choose three different pairs of dimensions whose products are 12, and draw the corresponding rectangles.

$$\begin{align*}A_1&=12\times1=12\text{ cm}^2\\A_2&=6\times2=12\text{ cm}^2\\A_3&=4\times3=12\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.mathematics: 12×1, 6×2 and 4×3 each have area 12 square centimetres.
